method: Each rename replaces the name value of one program, found by funder and program id, in the listed input file; the two funder renames replace every string equal to the old name in research/supplemental-funders.json. Ids are unchanged. Setting each value back restores the earlier files byte for byte, which tests/helpers/name-normalization-2026-11-22.mjs does for the historical audits.
